meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能用 Python 库 COBRApy 读取、构建和导出代谢模型,并运行通量平衡分析(FBA)、通量变异分析(FVA)、基因敲除、通量采样等计算,预测细胞生长等表型。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取、构建或导出代谢模型,运行 FBA/FVA/敲除等通量分析,或设计优化生长培养基时触发。

say.text: 加载教科书大肠杆菌模型,跑一次 FBA,告诉我生长速率是多少。
say.note: 会输出最优生长速率与该条件下的通量值。

say.text: 对大肠杆菌模型做单基因敲除筛选,列出必需基因。
say.note: 运行单基因敲除分析,输出基因生长结果。

say.text: 做一次通量变异分析(FVA),看 PFK 反应的通量范围。
say.note: 会返回各反应的最小/最大通量区间。

howto.what_en: With the Python library COBRApy, Claude can load, build, and export metabolic models and run FBA, FVA, gene/reaction knockouts, flux sampling, and other analyses to predict growth and phenotypes.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to load or build a metabolic model, run flux analyses such as FBA/FVA or knockout screens, or optimize growth media.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli textbook model, run FBA, and tell me the growth rate.
say_en.note: Returns optimal growth rate and flux values.

say_en.text: Run single-gene knockout screening on E. coli and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Runs single_gene_deletion and reports growth per gene.

say_en.text: Run flux variability analysis and show the flux range of the PFK reaction.
say_en.note: Returns min/max flux bounds per reaction.
